subject: Fisher's exact test - Error in if (mu > x) - if statement fails

messages.author: 20ce616abaebdab3
messages.subject: Fisher's exact test - Error in if (mu > x) - if statement fails
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have only 1 case and one control file with the following columns:
chrBase | Chromosome.SE | Start.SE | strand | coverage | freqC | freqT

I have filtered out coverages below 7 and there are no duplicate chrBase values.

I understand that in this case the calculateDiffMeth function is going to switch to fast.fisher function.
In line 480 of the code, the if statement fails and I get the error:

Error in if (mu > x) uniroot(function(t) mnhyper(t) - x, c(0, 1))$root else if (mu <  :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In dhyper(support, m, n, k, log = TRUE) : NaNs produced
2: In dhyper(support, m, n, k, log = TRUE) : NaNs produced

Any help would be much appreciaed

Bests
Mehran

Maybe it's not a bad idea to implement a warning message if the input file values are offset.

Thanks
Mehran
